biome_based_crops.guide.title: Biomes Notebook
biome_based_crops.guide.setup_text: A sealed room registers as a landkind when its required weather, native floor, and inside materials match; its natural mobs can then spawn there. Glasshouse growth outside direct thermoregulator coverage needs sky-exposed glass directly above each plant; the rest of the roof may be solid. A naturally matching room needs no AC. Otherwise, point an AC into the room and use one AC per 256 enclosed inside blocks. Separately, an active Electrical or Tough As Nails thermoregulator can support weather-based plants in a four-block front half-circle, one block above or below, without a glasshouse or overhead glass. Power or fuel and clear airflow are required; explicit landkind rules still apply. On Sable ships, crops follow the landkind at their current world location and local controllers move with them. Faint air wisps show leaks; seal them within one minute before the room weather returns toward its natural state.
biome_based_crops.ac.selector_usage: Click to cycle forward. Hold Shift or use the left arrow key to cycle backward.
